minimality: No selection of fewer than 44 of these 46 accepted packets covers the 1904-case union. Each of the 44 mandatory packets transfers a witness case that no other accepted packet transfers, so every covering selection contains all of them; they already cover the union, so nothing else is needed. The minimum selection is unique.
scope: Exact minimum within this fixed family of accepted field transfer sets; bookkeeping over retained receipts, with no field geometry rerun. Not a minimum over every possible field construction or mixed proof. Selected receipts keep their packets, audit proposals, cover, and D4 dependencies.
selection_tie_break: fewest complete angle rows, then packet hash order
